note.summary:
3.2 Media and technology
Key focus
- social media, online safety, devices, communication and digital habits.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use negatives carefully, give advantages and drawbacks, and distinguish direct speech from reported opinions.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: I use my phone to talk to friends and look at timetables.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“मैं फ़ोन से दोस्तों से बात करता हूँ और समय-सारिणी देखता हूँ।”

Give two uses of the phone.

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“मेरी बहन रोज़ तीन घंटे सोशल मीडिया पर बिताती है, शायद बहुत ज़्यादा।”

How much time does the sister spend online, and what is implied?

questions.modelAnswer: Yesterday I downloaded an app that helps me learn vocabulary.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“कल मैंने एक ऐप डाउनलोड किया जो मुझे शब्दावली सीखने में मदद करता है।”

What was downloaded, and how is it useful?

questions.modelAnswer: I never post photos of my home in order to protect my privacy.

“निजता की रक्षा के लिए मैं अपने घर की तस्वीरें कभी नहीं डालता।”

What does the speaker never do, and why?

questions.modelAnswer: A video call is convenient, but cannot replace a real visit.
questions.question:

“वीडियो कॉल सुविधाजनक है, लेकिन असली मुलाक़ात की जगह नहीं ले सकती।”

Give one advantage and one limitation of video calls.

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: Tomorrow I will change my password and update all programs.
questions.question:

“कल मैं अपना पासवर्ड बदलूँगा और सभी कार्यक्रम अपडेट करूँगा।”
